Name: Molag Lewis
Author: circxsking
Description:
No GenAI was used in the making of this mod.

[b]Some[/b] of Lewis' vanilla dialogue might've been replaced in the making of this mod.

You may get a SMAPI warning stating, "...Some of the game's content files were modified or corrupted. This may cause game crashes, errors, or other issues." when installing this mod. It's true that some of the files were modified of course. You should be fine, but report any bugs to me, of course.

Installation:
[list]
[*]You need SMAPI. I also recommend Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Drag the second Molag Lewis folder into common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]The XNB folder is not necessary in the MODS folder. You can remove the folder from there.[/*]
[*]Drag the Lewis.XNB file into the Stardew Valley/Content/Characters/Dialogue folder. Replace the file when prompted. (My Lewis.XNB file is located in the Lewis XNB folder.)[/*]
[*]Drag the ManorHouse.XNB file into the Stardew Valley/Content/Data/Events folder. Replace when prompted. This file is also located in the Lewis XNB folder.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Molag Lewis
Manifest.Description: Causes Lewis to talk like Molag Bal from The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
